confirmedIssues.title: Local mutation success is asserted even when browser storage did not change
confirmedIssues.mechanism: setConsent/clearConsent return void, swallow failed persistence and dispatch the requested state. The page optimistically writes that state and unconditionally toasts success. clearRecentPages swallows removeItem failure and notifies a reread, so unchanged nonzero history can accompany Recent pages cleared. A failed withdraw from stored accepted leaves getConsent()==accepted and required-policy reporting permission true even while the UI shows declined.

confirmedIssues.title: Throwing localStorage property access escapes the recent-pages recovery boundary
confirmedIssues.mechanism: typeof window.localStorage evaluates the property getter, which may throw SecurityError. hasStorage is not guarded, and load calls it before its getItem try/catch. PrivacyPage invokes getRecentPages during its state initializer, so this conditional capability failure throws before its independent sections render. cookieConsent guards the corresponding accessor, but that protection does not cover recentPages.
